test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the following sentence the underlined part contains an error. Alternatives to the underlined part are given as options. Select the correct alternative.

The house seemed much __far__ than she expected.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. farther.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"far"** refers to distance, and its comparative form is **"farther."**
 
• **"Farther"** is used for physical distance, while **"further"** is used for figurative or abstract distance.
 
• The given sentence requires the comparative form of "far," as it is comparing the distance to her expectations.
 
• Other options like **"farthest,"** **"farer,"** and **"more far"** are incorrect because:
 
 
• **"Farthest"** is the superlative form and is used when comparing three or more entities.
 
• **"Farer"** is not a valid word in English.
 
• **"More far"** is grammatically incorrect, as "farther" is the standard comparative form.
 
 

Correct sentence: *The house seemed much farther than she expected.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparatives:**

 
 
• Comparatives are used to compare two things.
 
• For adjectives with one syllable, add **"-er"** (e.g., "taller").
 
• For longer adjectives, use **"more"** before the adjective (e.g., "more beautiful").
 
 
 
• **Superlatives:**
 
 
• Superlatives are used to describe the highest degree among three or more things.
 
• For adjectives with one syllable, add **"-est"** (e.g., "tallest").
 
• For longer adjectives, use **"most"** before the adjective (e.g., "most beautiful").
